proposals.title: PROPOSAL 4 - SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING PROXY ACCESS BYLAW AMENDMENTS
proposals.proponent: Mr. James McRitchie and Ms. Myra K. Young
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend the proxy access bylaw to remove the limit on the number of stockholders who may aggregate shares to meet the 3% ownership threshold.
proposals.evidence: our board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this shareholder proposal

proposals.title: PROPOSAL 5 - SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING REPORT ON SUSTAINABLE PACKAGING
proposals.proponent: As You Sow, on behalf of the Michelle Swenson & Stan Drobac Revocable Trust and co-filers
proposals.topic_summary: Asks for a report on a comprehensive sustainable packaging policy, including recyclable cups, recycled content, removal of plastic straws, and reusable cup goals.
proposals.evidence: our board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this shareholder proposal

proposals.title: PROPOSAL 6 - SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING REPORT ON PAID FAMILY LEAVE
proposals.proponent: Zevin Asset Management, LLC, on behalf of the Claire L Bateman 1991 Trust and co-filers
proposals.topic_summary: Asks for a report evaluating the risk of employment discrimination from Starbucks's paid family leave approach, available by the 2019 annual meeting.
proposals.evidence: our board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this shareholder proposal

proposals.title: PROPOSAL 7 - SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING DIVERSITY REPORT
proposals.proponent: Trillium Asset Management LLC, on behalf of the Paul LeFort Revocable Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Asks for an annual diversity report with a chart of employees by gender and race across EEOC job categories and a description of diversity policies and programs.
proposals.evidence: our board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this shareholder proposal
